message.reasoning:
Working through the pipeline netlist now, comparing component positions against the image and ignoring the mismatched labels. I'm starting with the top-row PMOS at roughly x 611–646, which lines up with image M1.

I'm checking the image's PMOS devices against the netlist, since the labels don't line up. The net named GND seems to be absorbing supply and gate connections too, so those will need fixing. I'm listing the image's top-row and second-row transistors by position to work out the real topology.

I'm lining up the pipeline's M1 and M2 against their image counterparts by position, and I'm noting that M1's drain goes to net1 and its gate should sit on the bias net shared with M10, M7, M2 and M3.

Now I'm matching the pipeline's remaining transistors to their image counterparts by position, starting with M5 and M6. M7 drains to a net that should tie to M8, M16 and the gates of M16 and M17, so that GND label needs replacing.

Now I'm pairing the pipeline's remaining transistors with their image counterparts by position, looking at the M14–M23 range and the bottom-row devices.

Next I'm defining the bias net: the gates of M10, M7, M1, M2 and M3 tie together along the y=76 line. Its connection down near x=690 runs to the M5 drain and the M12 source, which I'm still tracing.

I'm tracing the bias net now: the drain of the M22 device runs up the x≈150 line to the same y=76 bias node, while its gate ties to the node shared with M20's drain.

I'm checking the bias net around M22 and M21: their gates tie to the node at (85,425), which also joins M20's drain and M23's drain. Then I'm moving on to the NB net that drives the PMOS cascode gates.

I'm checking the M9 drain and the x≈395 line that runs up toward the supply, along with how the NB node links to it near (462,155) and (395,215).

I'm checking whether the source of M9 sits on the VDD line, then following its drain down through the dot at (395,218) toward the M17 drain near y≈510 and seeing which gate that node feeds.

I'm checking the NB bias net: the gates of M11, M9, M8, M4, M5 and M6 tie to the M9 drain and the M17 drain, and the M21 drain joins them too. Next I'm looking at the cascode NMOS bias net C, starting with the dots at (305,272) and (350,272) near M11's drain.

I'm tracing the net C wiring: the drain of M11 runs down to the M18 drain and the gates of M14 and M12. I'm also checking how the M23 gate ties back up to the M4 and M14 drain line near x≈612.

I'm confirming that the line at y=257 runs across to x=690 and drops to the M15 and M13 gates, so that node matches the M4 and M14 drain. Next I'm mapping the pipeline's M14 drain, which is tied to ground, onto the image's M4 cascode and seeing what it should connect to.

I'm checking the pipeline's M8 drain against the M14 drain and the M16 gate, which should all sit on the same node. Next I'm confirming that M16's drain and source connect to net9 and net12 as expected, and I'm about to match M17's drain and source to net10 and net13.

Now I'm working out which ground pins are real ground and which are just unresolved nets, since the pipeline lumps VDD and the gates under GND. I'm sorting the sources of the top-row PMOS devices toward VDD and starting to check whether the M9 source also belongs on the supply line.

I'm checking whether M9's source actually ties to the VDD line running down from the top, since the pipeline lists it as GND when it should be the supply.

I'm settling that M9's source goes to VDD, the same as the other top-row PMOS devices, and that its gate and drain share the NB bias node. The pipeline's "GND" label on those supply pins is clearly wrong, so I need to separate the supply and ground nets.

Now I'm deciding how to name the supply pins: the sources currently marked GND that should really be VDD, and whether to give them their own net separate from the true ground nets.

Now I'm going through the pipeline's PMOS list one device at a time, checking each gate and source against the image. Most of the gates belong on the PB bias net and the sources on VDD, while M5 is the exception: its gate really is on ground, so that GND label stays.

Now I'm checking the pipeline's M7 against image M8, since its drain should run down toward the M16 drain near the bottom of the diagram.

Now I'm assigning the image's M11 drain and the M12 source to their pipeline counterparts, checking where that node meets the bottom-row devices.

Now I'm pinning down the pipeline's M11 and M12 nets: M11's drain joins the PB line, and the image M12 drain at x=763 ties to the same node. M13's gate sits on NB, its source is net6, and its drain becomes the NC node shared with the M18 and M14 gates.

Now I'm going through the NMOS devices: M14's drain goes to the shared ND4 node and its gate to NC, M15's drain runs to PB, and M16 and M17 pick up their gates on ND4. M18's drain ties to NB, and its gate is on net7.

I'm settling the remaining transistors in the bottom rows: M19 drains to PB with its source on ground, M20 drains and gates to NC, and M21 drains to the bias net with its gate on ND4. M22 and M23 are next, with their drains and gates tied to the nb2 and NB nodes.

Now I'm checking the Q4 base connection, which the pipeline has on a separate net even though the image ties it to ground, so I'll set that base pin to GND.

Now I'm assigning the pin names in the netlist: the Q1 emitter goes to the R1 node, Q2's emitter sits on net12, and Q3's emitter goes to R0. I'm settling on a naming scheme with VDD as its own net and separate names for the PB, NB, NC, ND4 and nb2 bias nodes, and I'm starting to set the M1 and M2 gate and source pins.

Now I'm assigning the remaining PMOS and NMOS pins: the sources go to VDD, the gates and drains get the bias nodes, and M5's gate stays on ground.

I'm finishing the netlist edits now: the M22 and M23 drain and gate nets, plus the Q4 base set to ground. I'm also double-checking that M23's gate really runs up to the ND4 node at the top, and I'm going to accept the M9 source on VDD even though I'm not fully certain of it.
